lines.zh: 两条腿跑起来，很快，很轻。
lines.en: Two legs, quick and light.

lines.zh: 我的名字意思是橡树蜥蜴。
lines.en: My name means oak lizard.

lines.zh: 我穿过蕨类，只听见沙沙声。
lines.en: I cross the ferns; only a rustle follows.
I keep to the edge of the herd.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴绷直，帮我转向。
lines.en: My tail goes stiff to help me turn.
I do not walk slowly. I can run at any moment.
I avoid the open ground.

lines.zh: 我踩在落叶上，几乎没声。
lines.en: I step on leaf litter, almost silent.
I follow my herd; we walk in a line.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在头两侧，看得广。
lines.en: My eyes sit at the sides; I see widely.
I lower my head for a bite of fern.

lines.zh: 我走到灌木边，先停一下。
lines.en: I reach the brush and stop first.

lines.zh: 我的后腿比前腿长得多。
lines.en: My hind legs are far longer than my forelegs.

lines.zh: 我转身用尾巴，不用脖子。
lines.en: I turn with my tail, not my neck.

lines.zh: 我站着，一条腿微微曲着。
lines.en: I stand with one leg slightly bent.
I could spring at any moment.
I chew fern slowly.
A twig snaps far off; I look up.
My herd grazes nearby.
There are fine lines on my hide.
I look at the sky a while.

lines.zh: 鼻子里喷出一小团白气。
lines.en: A small puff of white leaves my nostrils.

lines.zh: 我的前肢短，够不到高枝。
lines.en: My forelegs are short; I cannot reach high branches.
I turn my head to look behind.
I remember Late Jurassic wind.
I hold still like a fern.

lines.zh: 我在等最安静的那一刻。
lines.en: I wait for the quietest moment.
I hear it, then I don't.
You stand a head above me.
I look up; my neck tires.
Any leaves in your hand?
Not too close — my legs tremble.

lines.zh: 两边都有人，我夹在中间。
lines.en: People on both sides; I'm caught between.
Only when you stop do I dare breathe.
You know I can run, do you not?
You haven't been in these ferns before.

lines.zh: 我在看你的手，不看你的脸。
lines.en: I watch your hands, not your face.
My herd is calling.
Your shadow falls across my grazing.
I tilt my head, sizing you up.
I cry out and spring aside.
That left my legs shaking.
I retreat into the herd.
My hide is cut; there is little blood.
My chest works like a bellows.
I can still run, only slower.
My hind leg gives; I drop into the ferns.
This wound keeps me from stopping.
I squeal and bolt sideways.
Do not strike me again.
Leaves. Those are leaves.
I reach with a foreleg. Not far enough.
Lower it.
I come slowly and sniff first.
This smells tender.
Back off and I will eat.
I'll go after my herdmates finish.
I nip the tender edge first.
I'll share a little, keep half.
Hold it out — don't drop it.
You touched me; I sprang away.
My hind legs are sensitive.
That nearly knocked me over.

lines.zh: 我从你手够不到的地方过。
lines.en: I slip past where your hands can't reach.
My tail is pinned; I panic.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，我退一步。
lines.en: We crowded; I give a step.
The ferns are flattened under us.
You are much heavier.
All four feet hold; I don't fall.
Again, and I run.
There are many suitable in the herd.

lines.zh: 我们绕着圈子跑，很快就懂。
lines.en: We run in circles; it is quickly understood.
I flick my tail up.
This season the ferns are thick.
We graze side by side, quietly.
Something murmurs deep in my throat.
Step back so we can come together.

lines.zh: 我得先确认附近没有掠食者。
lines.en: First I check for predators.
The wind comes from her side.
We ran a stretch together.
I take a fern frond.

lines.zh: 果子沾了土，我还是吃了。
lines.en: It's dusty, but I eat it anyway.
My stubby forelimbs can't hold it.
Too heavy to lift; I push with my snout.
This is not a leaf.
It's bitter; I let it go.
It fell out of the tree.
There is a bug on it.
I boot it into the weeds.
Juice leaks from the corner of my mouth.
The grass bends — not the wind.
I raise my head and freeze.
That direction is wrong.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，准备跑。
lines.en: I turn side-on, ready to run.
It stands a shoulder taller than me.
The herd has stopped.
I give a short, sharp call.
My forefeet lift, ready to bolt.
I watch to see if it moves.
It lifts a foot; I tense with it.

lines.zh: 我盯住它的肩，看它要先动哪边。
lines.en: I watch its shoulder to see which way it will move.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了会把自己暴露。
lines.en: I stay quiet; a call would give me away.
I shift my weight onto my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我把它的影子刻进眼里。
lines.en: I burn its outline into my eyes.
I watch it while backing off.

lines.zh: 我不转身跑，那样更危险。
lines.en: I do not turn my back. That is worse.
I am measuring its distance.
It circles; I change direction.
The herd has gone into the trees.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴翘起来保持平衡。
lines.en: I lift my tail to keep my balance.

lines.zh: 它每近一步，我就退两步。
lines.en: Each of its steps, I take two back.
I am looking for the nearest brush.
It stands still; I don't dare run.
Another step and I'm gone.
I retreat along the brush without turning.

lines.zh: 它每停一次，我就多走两步。
lines.en: Each time it pauses, I gain two steps.
The herd is already in the trees.

lines.zh: 我听它的呼吸，判断它累不累。
lines.en: I listen to its breathing to judge if it tires.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴帮我保持平衡。
lines.en: My tail keeps me balanced.
My hind leg kicks out with little force.
I have no fangs, only legs.
That is enough to let me run.
I bite its sleeve.
My tail lashes out and hits nothing.
It swings; I leap clear.
I know — my kick can't hurt you.
After the blow I run for the trees.
I am no fighter. I am a runner.
Do not make me turn back.
I kick it in the shin.

lines.zh: 这一下，我用了全身的力。
lines.en: That used all my strength.
It let go; I run at once.
One kick, then I'm gone.
I rise out of the ferns.
My legs are thin; I wobble.

lines.zh: 第一眼看见的是蕨和光。
lines.en: The first thing I see: ferns and light.
Before running, I listen.
The leaf litter is soft.
Dirt slides off my back.
The ferns are tall enough to hide me.
I look up. The trees are tall.
I remember my own name.
Oak lizard. That is me.
I join the herd and we walk in line.
I choose a route I can run.
A sound far off. I remember it.

lines.zh: 我第一次抬腿，就学会了跑。
lines.en: My first lifted leg already knew how to run.
These ferns are enough to hide me.
The soil is new; I memorize it.
I head toward the herd.

lines.zh: 我刚睁眼，同伴已经在旁边。
lines.en: When my eyes opened, the herd was already beside me.
Fire catches my leg and I leap about.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，腿压在身下。
lines.en: I land with a leg trapped under me.

lines.zh: 我鼻孔朝上，还是呛了水。
lines.en: Nostrils up, and still I swallow water.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻在蕨丛里。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the ferns.
The arrow's fletching still quivers at my leg.

lines.zh: 身上一麻，我的腿不听使唤。
lines.en: A numbness takes my legs.
Too hungry to run.
The thunder freezes me.

lines.zh: 我蹬着空处，找不到落点。
lines.en: I kick at nothing, hunting for ground.
